ConcertCutter repère les applaudissement: ConcertCutter detects applause, announcements and tuning between tracks in a recorded concert, then lets you adjust every cut before exporting to WAV or MP4. Free, open source, and nothing leaves your computer.
D’un enregistrement d’une heure à des mo: Turn an hour-long recording into separate, named tracks without the applause or announcements. You have the final say on every cut.
Application locale qui découpe un concer: A local application that splits a recorded concert into tracks, removes applause, announcements and tuning, and exports audio or video tracks after your review.
Au premier lancement, c’est probable. L’: It probably will on first launch. The executable is unsigned, so SmartScreen displays a warning because it does not recognize the publisher. Select “More info” and then “Run anyway” after confirming that the file came from the official release. The guide explains this screen and how to verify the SHA-256 checksum.
Le découpage automatique est-il toujours: Are the automatic cuts always accurate?
No, and that is why the application includes editing tools. The analysis relies on drops in volume between tracks: an audience recording, two tracks that flow directly into each other, or speech over the music will need corrections. Every boundary remains adjustable, and you can add or remove them.
L’interface graphique ouvre les enregist: The graphical interface opens WAV recordings. The command-line tools described on GitHub support batch processing and more advanced settings.
Non. L’analyse, l’écoute, les correction: No. Analysis, playback, editing and exports all happen on your computer. The interface opens in your browser through a local server that is accessible only from your machine. The only possible download is the installation of FFmpeg if you choose to produce videos.

No. ConcertCutter is a single standalone .exe file: no Python, no system dependencies and no installation wizard. To remove it, move the file to the Recycle Bin; the guide explains where to delete automatic recovery data if you want to remove everything.
